stance_rationale: The negative screen-route conclusion is supported by the artifacts: rank-IC, ICIR, portfolio alpha, turnover, and decile shape all reject a long-only standalone alpha. The draft still needs revision because required challenge/lineage artifacts are missing, sector-neutral robustness is not tested, and the DPL-feature recommendation overreaches beyond the evidence.

sub_stability.note: Three tercile ICIRs are all negative: -0.429, -0.350, -0.244. Stable wrong-sign signal, not unstable alpha.

dsr.note: Not reported; package marks DSR n/a because selection_type=chain.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: alpha_scores.parquet has Date,Ticker,score with 79,039 rows and 254 monthly sig_dates. Package text claims 2005-01..2026-03, but the parquet ends at 2026-02-27 because the terminal 2026-03-31 signal has no forward-return row.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: No NEGATE_FACTORS/FLIP_SIGN observed; raw positive run-length orientation is retained even though realized IC is negative.
Comparator factors are loaded through load_month_factors() with PIT-safe direction alignment; core flow snapshots use Date < sig_date.
Factor DB comparators use load_month_factors(); direct investor/rawdata cache loads are task-specified sidecar inputs rather than direct Factor DB factor parquet loads.
No regime, drawdown, volatility, or overlay signal is used.
No fundamental accounting fields are used.

RF-A1.evidence: Subperiod direction is stable but negative.

RF-A2.evidence: Single-factor construction; no composite ICIR claim.

RF-A3.evidence: Recent 36-month ICIR is -0.407 versus full -0.333; magnitude ratio 1.22, below 1.5 and wrong sign.

RF-A4.evidence: No sector-neutral or size-neutral ICIR audit is present.

RF-A5.evidence: Top decile ADV p10 is about 2.15B KRW and only 0.28% of top-decile rows are below 2e8 KRW.

RF-A6.evidence: Six configs are reported and all are negative, but DSR is n/a and the DPL feature route is not multi-test adjusted.

RF-A7.evidence: alpha_scores is multi-date, not a single snapshot; weights.csv is absent, so portfolio schedule verification is unavailable.

critical_concerns.description: No alpha_challenge_note.md, artifact_lineage.json, finalized alpha_package.json, risk_package.json, optimization_package.json, weights.csv, or covariance.parquet exists in the worktask mailbox/artifact paths requested. This prevents independent No Silent Override and 3-source verification, even though the draft itself is candid.

The DPL_FEATURE recommendation is the weakest leap: the evidence proves a wrong-sign, high-turnover, unshortable standalone signal, but does not prove a long-only DPL learner can harvest it cost-aware by down-weighting names without recreating the same turnover and short-leg dependence.

RF-A4 is unresolved: no sector-neutral or size-neutral ICIR audit is reported. Flow run-length can proxy investor-coverage, size, liquidity, exchange, or sector participation, so the negative IC may be structurally real but not necessarily independent alpha information.

The draft misstates artifact details: alpha_scores.parquet ends at 2026-02-27, not 2026-03-31, and after universe restriction the per-date score mean/sd are not centered as claimed. This is not a single-snapshot bug, but it needs lineage correction before downstream use.

DSR is marked n/a and PG active-strategy correlation is absent. Because the package recommends retaining the signal as a feature, missing multi-testing and crowding checks matter even if the standalone capital route is rejected.

supporting_arguments: The core rejection is strong: rank_ic=-0.0307, ICIR=-0.333, Harvey_t=-5.38, portfolio_alpha_t=-1.28, net active SR=-0.263.
Decile evidence supports the package's contrarian interpretation: D10 active t=-0.58 and D10-D1 spread=-0.0059, with the positive effect in lower deciles.
Novelty versus INV09 is reasonably supported: monthly median Spearman is -0.330, below the stated absolute-correlation threshold.
RF-A7 is not triggered for alpha_scores: the parquet contains 254 monthly signal dates, not one static snapshot.
Liquidity is not the main blocker: top-decile ADV is broadly above the 2e8 KRW floor.
unresolved_disputes: Whether an inverted M36 score adds incremental value inside a cost-aware DPL model after INV09/INV10 and existing PG strategies.
Whether sector-neutral and size-neutral ICIR preserve the negative signal or reveal it as a coverage/liquidity/sector proxy.
Whether DSR should remain n/a for a chain build once the package recommends feature retention rather than disposal.
Why requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260621_007 and stage_artifacts/WT_D20260621_007 are missing while actual artifacts are under stage_artifacts/WT-D20260621_007.
Why weights.csv and covariance.parquet were requested for schedule/PSD checks but are absent.
weakest_assumption: The single most fragile claim is that a wrong-sign, high-turnover, short-leg/contrarian-only signal can still be safely retained as a useful long-only DPL feature without a cost-aware incremental feature backtest.
rebuttal_required: Provide alpha_challenge_note.md and artifact_lineage.json with RF-A1 through RF-A7 explicitly checked.
Correct the alpha_scores date range and normalization wording, or regenerate scores z-scored inside the final tradable universe if that is the intended contract.
Run sector-neutral and size-neutral IC/ICIR diagnostics for RF-A4.
If DPL_FEATURE is retained, show an incremental, cost-aware feature ablation versus INV09/INV10 and current PG active strategies.
Resolve or explicitly mark N/A for weights.csv and covariance.parquet schedule/PSD checks.
rationalization_red_flags: DSR gate not applicable (chain, not sweep)
A clean, faithfully-reported negative IS success
This is NOT a structural limit
all configs agree on the negative direction

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: I agree with the no-capital-admission conclusion, but not with approving the draft as complete. The evidence supports rejection of M36 as a standalone long-only alpha; the feature-retention route and packaging require further proof.

alpha_specific_questions: Does M36 retain any incremental predictive value after neutralizing sector, size, liquidity, and INV09/INV10 exposure?
Can a long-only, cost-aware DPL model use the negative M36 loading without violating the turnover ceiling or relying on an implicit short-leg effect?
Is the actual alpha_scores contract supposed to be z-scored across all cached names or only the final KOSPI200/KOSDAQ150 tradable universe?
